studies.name: Gurol-Urganci et al. — Mobile phone messaging reminders for attendance at healthcare appointments (Cochrane CD007458)
studies.draft_uses: 2013 publication (pub3), Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2013, Issue 12. Draft quotes RR 1.10 (7 studies, 5841 participants, moderate certainty) for text reminders vs no reminders.
studies.latest_known: The 2013 pub3 is the most recent version found (literature searched to August 2012; no update published since). However, the figure the draft quotes is WRONG for pub3: pub3 reports RR 1.14 (95% CI 1.03–1.26) from 7 studies, 5841 participants — not RR 1.10. RR 1.10 (95% CI 1.03–1.17) is the figure from the earlier pub2 (2012, 3 studies). The draft pairs the pub3 participant count (5841, 7 studies) with the pub2 effect estimate (RR 1.10), producing a hybrid figure that matches neither version.
studies.what_changed: Draft states RR 1.10 (7 studies, 5841 participants). The pub3 the draft cites reports RR 1.14 (95% CI 1.03–1.26) for those same 7 studies and 5841 participants. RR 1.10 is the pub2 figure (3 studies). The draft has merged the study count and participant number from pub3 with the effect estimate from pub2, yielding a figure that appears in neither version.
